high_means: A larger distinct population was brought from elsewhere as enslaved, indentured, or otherwise unfree labor.
bounded_exception: A source-bounded event whose defining mechanism is imported unfree labor may be adjudicated applicable even when the statistical triad is structurally N/A because no settler population exists.
public_display_correction_policy: A known frozen score may be source-corrected for public display when its positive cells concern the local affected population rather than a distinct population imported from elsewhere. The frozen score remains unchanged and the referent error is queued for the next release.

gate_rules.triad_zero: display zero; coerced settlers or detainees are a different construct
gate_rules.triad_positive: combine with known unfree-incomer share; preserve U as uncertainty
gate_rules.triad_unknown: suppress solid point and show full uncertainty
gate_rules.triad_structural_na: suppress as N/A unless a positive or unresolved unfree score creates a coding-review conflict
